jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, WebApp
jobs.description:
GET TO KNOW US

Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix, and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.



About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead the go-to-market engine for our newest, most explosive line of business: NodeZero WebApp Pentesting. You will be the entrepreneurial marketing lead for a massive expansion into the application security (AppSec) and Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) space. The market is currently being reshaped by AI hype, creating a distinct window of opportunity for a fierce competitor to seize total market ownership. You will report directly to the VP of Corporate & Product Marketing, partnering tightly with a world-class Product and Engineering team to turn deep technical capabilities into market dominance.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Go-To-Market Strategy & Launch Ownership

 - Own the end-to-end GTM strategy, messaging, and positioning for the NodeZero WebApp Pentesting product line from its launch to market dominance.

 - Architect an aggressive, pipeline-driven product launch framework that moves product marketing to a core revenue driver, not a corporate support function.

 - Define target personas across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial segments, building a product narrative that maps directly to clear conversion paths.



Competitive Positioning & Content Weaponization

 - Drive the competitive narrative, explicitly dismantling legacy DAST incumbents and exposing fragile, unscalable "agentic AI" wrappers.

 - Educate the market on why generic AI solutions suffer from exploding token costs, erratic inconsistency, and severe production risks, while positioning NodeZero’s combination of a deterministic foundation and surgical AI as the only enterprise-grade choice.

 - Develop proof-first product content, technical teardowns, and competitive battlecards that arm the sales force to win contested deals.



Product & Engineering Collaboration

 - Partner tightly with Product Leadership and Engineering teams, embedding yourself with the builders to transform highly complex offensive security capabilities into high-impact, market-facing narratives.

 - Translate deep technical breakthroughs, e.g. the autonomous, production-safe exploitation of complex business-logic flaws like BOLA and IDOR, into clear, hype-free value propositions.

 - Serve as the vital feedback loop between market realities, buyer pushback, and the product roadmap.



Sales Enablement & Foundation Building

 - Own the technical enablement motion for the direct sales force, SDRs, and channel partners including major VARs, resellers, and distribution partners.

 - Win the hearts and minds of cynical, hype-hating developers, AppSec leads, and red teamers who demand zero false positives, while effortlessly elevating the message to the CISO/VP level to tell a broader platform and cyber-resilience story.
   Build the foundational processes, sales tools, and customer story pipelines required to scale this product line.
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ years (PMM) or 8+ years (Senior PMM) of B2B product marketing experience, with meaningful time spent launching and scaling complex technical products in a high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity company.

 - Non-Negotiable Drive: High-agency, self-starting execution. You thrive in greenfield environments where processes don't exist yet, and you love the challenge of defining what "great" looks like from scratch.

 - Deep Technical Chops: A background as a former security practitioner, pen tester, technical marketer, or technical PMM who has shipped AppSec, ASPM, or AI-driven security products. You must understand application architecture and the adversarial mindset far deeper than just cybersecurity acronyms.

 - Dual-Altitude Communication: The rare ability to build deep trust with highly skeptical technical practitioners who demand absolute production safety, while seamlessly translating those technical truths into business resilience metrics for CISOs.

 - Demonstrated capability to manage high-stakes product launches, cross-functional lifecycles, and performance frameworks with a clear ROI lens.

 - Proficiency with Salesforce and product analytics tools for tracking launch metrics and pipeline attribution.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on experience with web application security testing tools (DAST, SAST, IAST) or ASPM platforms.

 - Deep understanding of the current LLM/Agentic AI security landscape and its practical architectural limitations.

 - Experience working in an account-based marketing (ABM) motion with highly targeted enterprise buyer personas.




TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

 - We are a fully remote company. This role requires up to 20% travel for key product launches, major industry events, customer interviews, and internal offsites.

 - Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.



Perks of Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.




COMPENSATION AND VALUES

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $180,000 - $230,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company on a mission to shift the advantage from attackers to defenders. Our flagship product, the NodeZero® platform, autonomously executes real attack techniques in production—safely, without agents or disruption—to help organizations find exploitable weaknesses, fix what matters most, verify remediation, and continuously prove their resilience.



NodeZero helps organizations understand risk across their internal networks, external attack surface, cloud environments, identities, data, and web applications. Customers use the platform to replace assumptions with evidence: what an attacker can actually exploit, how an attack can move through the environment, what the business impact could be, and whether a fix truly worked.



We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We are committed to solving common security problems including ineffective tools, false positives, alert fatigue, blind spots, checkbox security culture, cybersecurity skills shortages, and the time and expense of point-in-time manual assessments. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls committed to respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.



As a remote-first company, we require a minimum 25Mbps consumer-grade broadband connection.



What You'll Do

We are looking for a Director of Product Marketing to lead the product marketing function at a defining moment in Horizon3’s growth. This role will establish the strategy, operating model, and talent system that turn product marketing into a measurable engine for category leadership, pipeline creation, sales productivity, customer adoption, and revenue growth.



You will report to the VP of Corporate & Product Marketing and lead a team of product marketers, currently expected to include three direct reports. You will work across Product, Engineering, Attack Research, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Corporate Communications, Alliances, and Revenue Operations to ensure Horizon3’s capabilities are understood, differentiated, adopted, and converted into business outcomes.



Product Marketing Strategy & Category Leadership

 - Define and execute the product marketing strategy across the NodeZero platform, aligning portfolio priorities with Horizon3’s corporate narrative, growth objectives, market opportunity, and revenue plan.

 - Establish a clear architecture for how Horizon3’s capabilities—including internal, external, cloud, identity, Kubernetes, web application, precision defense, threat detection and response, and compliance solutions—fit together as one proactive security platform.

 - Lead the evolution of Horizon3’s market position from autonomous pentesting and adversarial exposure validation toward a broader, evidence-based proactive security and CTEM operating model.

 - Translate product and market strategy into clear buyer narratives for CISOs, security leaders, SecOps, ITOps, cloud-security, identity, application-security, infrastructure, compliance, and offensive-security teams.

 - Identify the highest-value market opportunities, buying centers, use cases, and customer segments, then prioritize product marketing investment against business impact.

 - Serve as a senior product marketing voice in executive planning, annual operating plans, board preparation, analyst engagements, industry events, and strategic customer conversations.



Product Launch & Go-To-Market Operating System

 - Create and scale a repeatable launch methodology that aligns Product, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Communications, and channel teams around one plan.

 - Establish launch principles, stage gates, briefs, roles, timelines, readiness requirements, measurement standards, and post-launch reviews.

 - Ensure every launch begins with a validated customer problem, a differentiated market position, a clear audience, proof points, a field activation plan, and defined business outcomes.

 - Oversee the development of messaging, positioning, pricing and packaging inputs, buyer journeys, launch content, campaign requirements, enablement, analyst materials, and customer communications.

 - Create a consistent process for moving product feedback, field intelligence, customer evidence, and competitive insights back into Product and executive decision-making.

 - Measure launch performance and use results to improve future launches, portfolio investment, and go-to-market efficiency.



Team Leadership & Talent Development

 - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing product marketing team with clear charters, ownership boundaries, priorities, and measures of success.

 - Set a high bar for strategic thinking, technical fluency, customer empathy, writing quality, operating discipline, and commercial impact.

 - Build an effective portfolio model that allows individual PMMs to own their areas while maintaining consistent company-wide messaging, process, and standards.

 - Recruit, onboard, mentor, and retain exceptional product marketing talent as the organization grows.

 - Establish regular team operating rhythms including planning, work-in-progress reviews, launch reviews, skill development, and performance conversations.

 - Create opportunities for the team to build reusable assets, deepen customer and market expertise, and increase leverage through repeatable systems and AI-assisted workflows.



Revenue Alignment, Enablement & Customer Adoption

 - Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to define how product marketing contributes to pipeline, conversion, deal velocity, win rates, expansion, retention, and customer value.

 - Develop a consistent enablement system spanning messaging, discovery, qualification, solution narratives, demo guidance, objection handling, competitive responses, sales plays, and training.

 - Ensure the field can communicate both technical proof—real attacks, exploitable paths, verified impact, and verified fixes—and executive value, including reduced exposure, faster remediation, and defensible security assurance.

 - Partner with Customer Success and Customer Marketing to create adoption, expansion, advocacy, and customer-proof programs that connect product use to measurable outcomes.

 - Establish a structured process for capturing win/loss insights, customer feedback, field requests, and recurring objections, then convert those insights into action.

 - Build scalable campaign-in-a-box and partner-ready packages that allow regional, field, channel, and demand teams to activate product narratives consistently.



Messaging, Content & Market Influence

 - Own the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of Horizon3’s product narratives across the full customer journey.

 - Guide the creation of proof-first content including product pages, solution briefs, technical blogs, buyer’s guides, white papers, customer stories, webinars, executive POVs, analyst materials, demos, and presentations.

 - Ensure technical claims are accurate, differentiated, supportable, and grounded in customer evidence, product capability, or validated research.

 - Partner with Corporate Communications, Analyst Relations, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and Alliances to amplify product stories through integrated programs.

 - Help Horizon3 educate the market on the shift from vulnerability volume and theoretical risk to verified exploitability, prioritized remediation, and continuous resilience.

 - Build a durable content and evidence system that makes high-quality product marketing faster to produce, easier to reuse, and more effective in-market.



Product, Engineering & Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Serve as a trusted strategic partner to Product and Engineering leadership, helping connect roadmap decisions to customer problems, market shifts, competitive dynamics, and commercial opportunity.

 - Establish productive working relationships with Attack Research and technical subject-matter experts so the company’s deepest capabilities become understandable and valuable to the market.

 - Represent the customer and market perspective in portfolio planning, prioritization, packaging, launch readiness, and roadmap discussions.

 - Resolve cross-functional ambiguity by clarifying decision rights, owners, dependencies, and next actions.

 - Build alignment across a fast-moving global organization without relying solely on formal authority.

 - Model direct, evidence-based, and respectful communication in high-stakes decisions and executive conversations.



AI Operations Transformation & Marketing Excellence

 - Lead the product marketing organization’s adoption of AI-assisted workflows that improve research, content development, personalization, competitive analysis, enablement, reporting, and operational scale.

 - Define responsible standards for using AI in product marketing while protecting accuracy, security, brand quality, customer trust, and human judgment.

 - Identify high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work, accelerate time to insight, and improve the quality and consistency of PMM outputs.

 - Build shared systems, templates, prompt libraries, knowledge resources, and quality-control practices that increase team leverage without creating disconnected one-off experiments.

 - Use data, automation, and structured feedback loops to continuously improve the product marketing operating model.



Measurement, Planning & Business Management

 - Define the product marketing scorecard, including launch readiness, pipeline influence, conversion, competitive performance, sales productivity, content engagement, adoption, expansion, and customer-proof metrics.

 - Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, and marketing leadership on planning, budget allocation, headcount planning, forecasting, and resource tradeoffs.

 - Establish reliable reporting that communicates progress, business impact, risks, dependencies, and recommended actions to executive leadership.

 - Use Salesforce, product analytics, market intelligence, win/loss data, and customer insights to make investment decisions and improve performance.

 - Hold the function accountable for outcomes, not activity volume, while preserving the quality and rigor required for a technical cybersecurity category.



What You’ll Bring

 - 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience, including significant experience in enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, or another complex technical category.

 - 4+ years of experience leading, coaching, or managing product marketers and building high-performing cross-functional teams.

 - Demonstrated success defining product marketing strategy and operating models across multiple products, segments, or buying centers.

 - A track record of launching and scaling complex technical products with measurable impact on pipeline, revenue, adoption, retention, or market position.

 - Strong understanding of cybersecurity markets, buyer journeys, competitive dynamics, and the process of turning technical differentiation into commercial advantage.

 - The ability to move fluently between executive strategy and technical detail, building trust with board-level leaders, product executives, sales teams, engineers, security practitioners, and customers.

 - Exceptional writing, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

 - Experience building repeatable launch, enablement, content, customer-insight, and measurement systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, create clarity, and drive decisions across a high-growth organization.

 - Strong business judgment, analytical skills, and comfort using data to prioritize investments and assess performance.



Nice to Have

 - Experience marketing offensive security, autonomous security, cloud security, identity security, application security, exposure management, CTEM, vulnerability management, security operations, or adjacent enterprise cybersecurity products.

 - Experience working with a product-led, sales-led, partner-led, or hybrid go-to-market model.

 - Experience supporting analyst relations, executive thought leadership, category creation, customer advisory programs, or major industry events.

 - Experience using AI and automation to transform marketing operations, research, content, enablement, or reporting.

 - Experience working with Salesforce, product analytics, marketing automation, customer intelligence, and business-intelligence tools.

 - Experience in a fast-growth company that has scaled its product portfolio, customer base, and go-to-market organization quickly.



What We’re Looking For

 - Strategic and commercial: you connect market insight, product strategy, customer value, and revenue outcomes.

 - A multiplier: you make the people and teams around you more effective through clarity, coaching, standards, and reusable systems.

 - High agency with sound judgment: you move quickly, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and know when to go deep or simplify.

 - Influential and collaborative: you align diverse stakeholders around a clear point of view and create momentum without unnecessary process.

 - Evidence-based: you prefer customer proof, measurable outcomes, and validated claims over generic positioning or unsupported hype.

 - Builder-minded: you are comfortable creating the operating model, talent systems, and standards required for the next stage of growth.



Travel Requirements

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. What You'll Do:

Horizon3 is investing in a company-wide data strategy to make our data trusted, governed, and built to power revenue growth. The Senior Product Analytics Engineer sits at the center of that effort: you're the bridge between how product data is modeled and built and how it's trusted and used across the company.

You'll work hand-in-hand with Data Engineering to help shape the canonical product data layer at the source, with the emerging Data Governance function to get metrics certified and documented, and with the Product analysts and PMs to turn that foundation into self-service, decision-ready data products. You're equally comfortable writing a dbt model, troubleshooting a pipeline, and helping a non-technical stakeholder define a company wide KPI.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines and data models that translate raw product usage and event telemetry into trusted, well-documented analytics assets.

 - Partner with Product Engineering on the canonical product data layer — ensuring product usage cohorts and behavioral signal definitions are built on accurate, governed source data, not just what's convenient downstream.

 - Partner with the new Data Governance function: support taxonomy definition work, prepare metrics for certification, and maintain documentation to governance standards (including AI/machine-readable structure).

 - Build and own the semantic layer and self-service data models for Product Analytics, so internal stakeholders can query with confidence without needing a SQL expert in the room every time.

 - Own data quality monitoring and anomaly detection for product usage data specifically, partnering with Data Engineering when issues trace back to pipeline or platform-level causes.

 - Contribute analytics engineering support to the expansion/upsell cohort work, building the pipelines and models that turn usage thresholds, feature adoption, and seat utilization into certified, production-grade metrics.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Rapid Response
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.



About the Role

Horizon3 http://Horizon3.ai is in search of a highly motivated and technically skilled Staff Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of NodeZero Rapid Response. This role requires a strong blend of product leadership, cybersecurity expertise, threat intelligence experience, technical depth, and customer empathy to help organizations quickly understand whether emerging vulnerabilities create real, exploitable risk in their environments.

The Staff Product Manager for Rapid Response will own the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and operating model for NodeZero Rapid Response. This leader will partner closely with the Attack Team, Engineering, Data, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Support to define how Horizon3 monitors emerging threats, determines which vulnerabilities matter, maps those threats to customer environments, validates real-world exploitability, and helps customers take action before attackers do.




RESPONSIBILITIES


RAPID RESPONSE PRODUCT STRATEGY & LEADERSHIP

 - Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for NodeZero Rapid Response, helping customers understand and respond to emerging vulnerabilities based on real exploitability and customer-specific risk.

 - Establish the end-to-end operating model for Rapid Response, from initial threat signal through research, prioritization, customer relevance analysis, exploit/test development, notification, remediation, retesting, and verification.

 - Set clear ownership, decision rights, service-level expectations, and operating rhythms across the teams required to deliver Rapid Response at speed.

 - Drive standardization and scalability across Rapid Response research, customer communications, integrations, and operational workflows.




EXPLOIT INTELLIGENCE & COVERAGE STRATEGY

 - Establish and grow exploit-intelligence relationships with security vendors, researchers, and other relevant intelligence providers to identify emerging Rapid Response opportunities as early as possible.

 - Define the threat intelligence strategy for Rapid Response across vendor advisories, CVEs, CISA KEV, public research, exploit repositories, attacker activity, and other sources of vulnerability and exploit intelligence.

 - Develop a prioritization framework for determining which vulnerabilities warrant immediate Rapid Response coverage based on exploitability, attacker utility, prevalence, customer footprint, potential impact, and evidence of exploitation in the wild.

 - Partner directly with vulnerability researchers and attack engineers to assess exploit prerequisites, affected products and versions, attack techniques, mitigations, and the evidence and production-safety controls needed to validate exploitability in customer environments.




CUSTOMER RELEVANCE, EXPLOITABILITY & AUTOMATION

 - Build capabilities that identify which customers, environments, and assets are potentially affected by an emerging threat using asset intelligence, technology fingerprinting, exposure context, historical NodeZero data, and other relevant signals.

 - Drive the product, onboarding, and Customer Success motion required to get 100% of customers to run EAD and keep discovery current so Rapid Response notifications can be relevant and actionable.

 - Drive automation that accelerates exploit and test development, including reusable research and exploit-development workflows, AI-assisted analysis, automated data collection, quality gates, and production-safety checks.

 - Define and monitor operational metrics such as time from disclosure to threat assessment, time to customer relevance determination, time to test availability, alert precision, validation coverage, remediation rates, and retest rates.




CUSTOMER ADOPTION, GROWTH & GO-TO-MARKET

 - Track Rapid Response test rates by event, customer, segment, and technology to ensure the offering is delivering measurable customer value and to identify adoption gaps that require product or go-to-market action.

 - Own Rapid Response attach-rate analysis and define customer-level triggers for renewals, new ARR, and expansion when an event is relevant to a customer's technology stack, industry, or exposure profile.

 - Partner with Alliances, Channel, and Marketing to turn Rapid Response intelligence and event content into partner plays, enablement, packaging, and campaigns that accelerate attach rates and qualified demand.

 - Define the measurement funnel from threat event to awareness, customer notification, test execution, remediation, pipeline influence, retention, and expansion, and use those insights to improve the product and go-to-market motion.




CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION, UX & REPORTING

 - Own the quality of the Rapid Response user experience and reporting, ensuring customers can quickly understand whether they are affected, see proof, take action, communicate results internally, and confidently demonstrate the value of the product.

 - Define how Rapid Response fits into customer security operations through notifications, APIs, ticketing, SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and other security and IT workflows.

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Channel, and Support to drive launches, enablement, customer education, adoption, event response, and feedback loops for Rapid Response.

 - Engage directly with CISOs, vulnerability management teams, SOC teams, incident responders, security researchers, prospects, and partners to understand emerging-threat response workflows and unmet needs.




TRAVEL REQUIRED

 - Hybrid role is located in San Francisco, New York, or Washington DC.  Role may require up to 20% travel to be successful.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of Product Management experience building deeply technical B2B SaaS products, with significant cybersecurity experience and depth in one or more domains such as vulnerability management, exposure management, offensive security, incident response, SOC operations, attack surface management, endpoint security, or threat detection and response.

 - Threat intelligence experience is required. You have hands-on experience working in or closely with cyber threat intelligence, vulnerability intelligence, threat research, emerging-threat response, or a closely related discipline.

 - Strong technical understanding of the vulnerability and exploitation lifecycle—including CVEs, CISA KEV, vendor advisories, proof-of-concept exploits, exploitation in the wild, affected products and versions, exploit prerequisites, mitigations, and remediation—with enough depth to work directly with vulnerability researchers and attack engineers on safe exploitability validation.

 - Experience translating threat intelligence into actionable customer outcomes rather than simply presenting feeds, scores, or lists of vulnerabilities.

 - Experience building products that combine multiple sources of telemetry, intelligence, and customer context to make high-confidence decisions.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to make decisions quickly when information is incomplete, the threat landscape is changing rapidly, and emerging vulnerabilities require response outside normal business hours.

 - Proven ability to work closely with engineers, designers, researchers, and security practitioners to translate complex technical capabilities into scalable product experiences.

 - Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience using customer feedback, threat data, product analytics, and operational metrics to prioritize investments and communicate clearly with customers, executives, and go-to-market teams.
